summary: The v40 mismatch is the missing whole worm.c:worm_move behavior after a long-worm head has moved. C inserts a visible segment at the previous head square, appends the new hidden head, updates the growth clock, and either grows/heals or drops the oldest tail segment. JS monmove.js:m_move currently records note_unported after moving the head, so it leaves the old tail coordinates and skips worm_move’s rnd/rn1/d calls. The same C function is called by mattacku, use_defensive, use_misc, and munslime; their existing JS adapters also record this same missing helper.

source.branch: A monster with nonzero wormno has had its head moved; worm_move inserts the old-head segment, appends the new hidden head, and updates growth time and HP when wgrowtime[wormno] <= svm.moves, otherwise removing the oldest visible tail segment.
callers: monmove.c:m_move() calls worm_move(mtmp) after remove_monster/place_monster and msg_mon_movement at 2051-2058; js/monmove.js:m_move currently records note_unported at 4221-4222.

mhitu.c:mattacku() calls worm_move(mtmp) after moving a ceiling-hiding long worm onto the hero square and before retrying enexto when the tail occupies the candidate square at 584-590; js/mhitu.js:mattacku currently records note_unported at 1642-1645.

muse.c:use_defensive() calls worm_move after moving a worm onto a trapdoor at 1054-1059 and a teleport trap at 1150-1155; js/muse.js:use_defensive has matching note_unported sites at 1004-1005 and 1106-1107.
muse.c:use_misc() calls worm_move after moving a worm onto a polymorph trap at 2534-2540; js/muse.js:use_misc records note_unported at 1627-1628.

muse.c:munslime() retains a guarded worm_move after forced relocation to a trap at 3128-3132 (commented as normally unreachable for worms); js/muse.js:munslime retains the corresponding guarded note_unported at 3261-3263.
dependencies: worm.c:count_wsegs() supplies the current hidden-head-inclusive segment count; js/worm.js:count_wsegs() already implements the count.
worm.c:shrink_worm() is the non-growing branch callee; js/worm.js:shrink_worm() already removes the oldest tail node and redraws it.
mon.c:mcalcmove(worm, FALSE) supplies the existing-speed divisor when a nonzero growth clock is reset; js/mon.js:mcalcmove() already implements this source function.
rm.h:place_worm_seg is the source macro that writes the worm into level.monsters[x][y]; js/worm.js owns the same level-local monster grid and ordered segment array.
display.c:newsym redraws the newly placed tail segment; js/display.js:newsym() is already used by worm.js redraw helpers.
rng.c:rnd(), rn1(), and d() supply the growth-clock and HP draws; js/rng.js already exposes all three operations.

The saved v40 evaluation first diverges at segment 0, step 32, key l: C draws rnd(5)=1 from worm_move(worm.c:224), while JavaScript next draws rn2(5)=0; the same frame has C tail glyph ~ and JavaScript floor glyph . at row 4, column 18. The prior 32 screens and all 33 cursor positions match.

Upstream worm.c:worm_move() at lines 196-278 first places a segment at the previous head coordinate and redraws it (204-206), appends a hidden node at the current head coordinate (211-216), then checks wgrowtime <= svm.moves (218). For a newly initialized worm it sets wgrowtime to svm.moves + rnd(5) (222-224); for later growth it uses mcalcmove(worm,FALSE), rn1(10,2), integer division by max(mmove,1), and svm.moves (225-238). It then computes the segment-based HP limit, draws d(2,2), and applies the previous-max/limit cap branches (240-270); otherwise it calls shrink_worm (271-276).

The selected recording is challenges/cases/v40/v40-worm-head-move-tail-shift-two-turns-cfirst.session.json. It creates a hostile long worm with #wizgenesis, then moves it twice east. At the second move, the C worm_move redraw and RNG entries are missing from JS because js/monmove.js:m_move only records note_unported after moving the head.

The direct C call inventory is six sites across monmove.c:m_move, mhitu.c:mattacku, muse.c:use_defensive (two trap types), muse.c:use_misc, and muse.c:munslime. Each corresponding current JS site has a note_unported("worm.c worm_move") placeholder; full-function completion must wire the shared helper at each source-ordered site. The munslime caller remains guarded and carries the source comment that worms normally do not reach it.

The existing worm state uses level.worms[wormno] = {segments, growtime}; initworm initializes growtime to zero, count_wsegs and shrink_worm are already present, and source-positioned JS helper calls can own the same movement and HP changes without expanding into worm_nomove or unrelated worm functions.
